To find the final cost, we will break down the problem into steps: calculating the total number of tickets, determining the gross cost, and then applying the discount.

The club buys 4 packs, and each pack contains 11 tickets.
$$ \text{Total tickets} = 4 \times 11 = 44 \text{ tickets} $$

**Step 2: Calculate the gross cost before discount.**
Each ticket costs 2 dollars.
$$ \text{Gross cost} = 44 \text{ tickets} \times 2 \text{ dollars/ticket} = 88 \text{ dollars} $$

The seller gives a single discount of 10 dollars on the entire purchase.
$$ \text{Final cost} = \text{Gross cost} - \text{Discount} $$
$$ \text{Final cost} = 88 - 10 = 78 \text{ dollars} $$

The final cost is 78 dollars, which is a whole number.

Answer: 78
